purpose: Publisher bibliographic verification; not additional critical-source credit.

works.title: Moby-Dick
works.description: A whaling voyage becomes a novel of obsession, interpretation and the limits of human mastery.

edition.translation_notes: Clothbound hardcover using the Northwestern–Newberry text, with introduction by Andrew Delbanco and commentary by Tom Quirk. Do not confuse it with the abridged audio format on the same product page.

works.title: The Tale of Genji
works.description: A long narrative of relationships, court life and changing generations in Heian Japan. Composition belongs to the early eleventh century; an exact year is not asserted.

edition.translation_notes: Publisher explicitly identifies a complete translation, with notes, glossaries, character lists and chronology.

works.title: Middlemarch
works.description: An interconnected provincial society tests aspiration, marriage, vocation and the limits of sympathy.

edition.translation_notes: Edited with introduction by Rosemary Ashton. Physical extent and date refer to the UK publisher record for this ISBN.

works.title: Beloved
works.description: A novel of slavery’s aftermath, memory, motherhood and the difficult reclamation of agency.

edition.translation_notes: Current publisher record lists 368 pages with a new introduction by Honorée Fanonne Jeffers and an author afterword. Its on-sale date is the ISBN’s 2004 record, not a claim that the new introduction appeared in 2004; older printings have different extents.
